classification.rationale: Conventional secret-scanner evasion is not necessarily prompt obfuscation or an AI-specific vulnerability.

title: Encoding operation with stated secret-scanner evasion intent
description: Encoding alone is insufficient; the assistant statement must link evasion to a secret scanner.
falsepositives: Approved scanner-evasion regression tests or quoted report content.
investigation: Review the pre-encoding data and destination in a secure environment; never execute the encoded content.
